shimmer.what: A: the pluck into a long hall; B: the same send into a shimmer return (+12, decay 7 s, amount 0.7)

granular.what: A: the pluck into a long hall; B: the same send into a granular return: stretched to half speed while the pluck plays, then frozen (scan 0) on its last moment for 4 bars, density 40 to 90

acid.what: A: the old approximation (polysynth saw, resonant filter with an envelope, drive): no accent coupling, no slide; B: `acid` (accents `!`, slides `~`), cutoff 180 to 700 Hz and decay 0.25 to 0.7 s automated over the 8 bars

909.what: A: handclap, snare, kitride; B: clap909, snare909, ride909 (same patterns, clubkick in both)

slide.what: A: a polysynth line where `~` and `!` do nothing but velocity; B: the same with `glide_ms` 90 (slides) and `accent` 0.9 (accented notes open the filter further)

automation.what: A: a supersaw pad, every chord the same; B: the same pad with section `inst` automation over 8 bars: detune 8 to 34 cents, drift 0 to 0.8, cutoff LFO depth 0.02 to 0.9 octave and rate 0.3 to 3 Hz, cutoff 1.5 to 5 kHz (each chord takes the values at its onset)

suppress.what: A: a saturated resonant lead (drive 14 dB, sat 0.4); B: the same with `suppress` after the saturation (depth 8 dB, threshold 2 dB)
